title: Auterion: P2 or Watch?
detail: The Target Companies registry in forge-policy lists Auterion as P2 (seed recommendation, TC-016). The 2026-10-17 priority-employer amendment in CONTROL puts Auterion on the secondary watch list with no priority (software-heavy autonomy stack, low manufacturing ownership). Web discovery reads the registry, so today Auterion is searched at least daily as P2.
blocks: Which tier web discovery uses for Auterion.
action: Answer in chat with the option you want; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
